nurse.text: Shwmae, cariad! Croeso to Merthyr Sanctuary. You look like you've walked up the valley in the rain. Which you have.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There we are. A cup of tea, a Welsh cake each, and a sit by the radiator, where the ironmasters never sat.
Right as rain! Better than rain, actually, because rain's what we've got. Hwyl fawr, bach.
The Ark's in the corner, love. It hums a bit when the trains go by. They say it hums a hymn.

else.text: No bother at all. Diolch for popping in.
